newsitem.title: INDIA: India castorseed climbs on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: India castorseed climbs on speculative buying.

text.p: Castorseed December delivery climbed from 1,152/1,153 rupees to 1,158/1,159 rupees per quintal on fresh speculative buying on Wednesday, dealers said.
"Sliding arrivals at the producing centres, fresh export buying and rising global prices triggered renewed bull interest," one dealer said.
"Export deals for Indian castor oil were done at the rate of 715/720 dollars per tonne," another dealer said.
Groundnut oil fell from 444/445 rupees to 434/435 rupees per 10 kg as demand petered out at peak levels. In Rajkot spot oil fell from 710/715 rupees to 675/680 rupees per 15 kg.
